run_model_runtime_benchmark: run a Caffe2 model runtime latency benchmark for a given device and input dimensions
run_load_pb: run load_pb to load a Caffe2 protobuf model and generate workspace blobs
run_parse_args: run parse_args to parse CLI arguments for model path, device, and input dimensions
refactor_load_pb: refactor load_pb to support loading models with custom init paths
review_main: review the main function that benchmarks multiple models and prints network runtime latency
